title: msiexec /qn from an unelevated process fails with 1925 and never shows UAC
symptoms: User reports no UAC dialog ever appeared
explanation: /qn suppresses ALL UI including the UAC elevation prompt itself, so an unelevated caller installing a perMachine MSI fails silently with 1925 — no dialog ever appears. Shell out through Start-Process -Verb RunAs, which triggers UAC regardless of the child command's /qn.
